name: conflictlens
description: AI-powered semantic conflict and security risk detection — flags issues before merge.

conflictlens.autoScan.description: When true, ConflictLens will automatically scan for risks every time a file is saved (debounced, 2 s).

conflictlens.apiEndpoint.description: URL of the local ConflictLens analysis server. Leave empty to use built-in analysis / mock data.

conflictlens.apiTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for the local analysis API or Gemini before treating the request as timed out. Default 8000ms matches the PRD's ~5–10 s performance target.

conflictlens.aiApiKey.description: Your AI API key (Gemini API key). Used with Gemma 4 (gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) to generate plain-English explanations and recommendations for each detected risk. Leave empty to skip AI enrichment.

conflictlens.proxyUrl.description: URL of the ConflictLens hosted AI proxy (e.g. https://your-proxy.onrender.com). When set, AI explanations are served from the proxy and count against the free-scan allowance. Leave empty to use your own AI API key directly.

conflictlens.modelId.description: Model ID used for direct AI calls. Default: gemma-4-26b-a4b-it. Alternatives: gemma-4-31b-it (stronger reasoning), gemma-4-4b-it (lower latency).

scripts.compile: npm run compile:webview && npm run compile:ext
